eventDetail.scope: The 28th International Multi-Topic Conference (INMIC 2026), hosted by the University of Engineering and Technology (UET), Lahore, is being organized in collaboration with the IEEE Lahore Section, IEEE Communications Society Lahore Chapter, IEEE Computer Society Lahore Chapter, and IEEE Education Society Lahore Chapter. It will provide an international forum for researchers, engineers, industry professionals, educators, and students to present original research and practical innovations in computing, communications, electrical engineering, electronics, and emerging technologies. Its scope includes artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software and systems engineering, cybersecurity, network security, parallel and distributed computing, edge and cloud computing, and biomedical, electrical, and electronic engineering. INMIC 2026 will promote interdisciplinary research, practical solutions, knowledge exchange, technology transfer, and academia–industry collaboration.
